## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.8 makes the Manager easier to follow live, strengthens code-aware context, and keeps shared memory work more dependable.

### A more live, navigable Manager

Manager now keeps its project, graph, memory, and source views up to date through scoped live updates instead of making you wait for a broad refresh. Library search and memory navigation are clearer, including direct links between related reviews and memories.

### Faster, stronger code-aware context

Threadnote can build and verify code-graph embeddings in the background after an index is ready. Context Brief grounds task guidance in current cited source, while graph work better preserves bounded project membership and recovers cleanly when background work is interrupted.

### Safer shared-memory reconciliation

Shared memory sync now recognizes and reconciles existing shared edits more carefully. Cursor Cloud shares can also be discovered when you have not selected a team explicitly, making shared context easier to find without weakening existing ownership and review controls.

### Clearer long-running work

Long-running workflow operations run as durable background jobs with clearer progress and recovery information. They keep their work bounded and leave results available for review when you return.
